info.name: CareerVeda API
info.description:
Every endpoint in the Express backend, plus the two Vercel functions.

**Start here:** set `baseUrl`, `adminEmail`, `adminPassword` in the collection variables, then run `Auth > Login`. Its test script writes `accessToken` and `csrfToken` for everything else.

Auth model: Bearer access token for admin routes; httpOnly `cv_refresh` cookie + `X-CSRF-Token` header for refresh/logout only; a shared secret for the cron sync.

All responses use `{success, data, meta}`; lists add `meta.pagination`.

request.description: Always 200 while the process is up. Does NOT check MongoDB.
200 when MongoDB is connected, 503 when it is not.
404s in production on purpose.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login first — its test script populates {{accessToken}} for the whole collection.

request.description: Run this first. The test script stores accessToken + csrfToken as collection variables; every other request reads {{accessToken}}. Sets cv_refresh (httpOnly) and cv_csrf cookies. Rate limit: authLimiter.
Cookie-authenticated (cv_refresh), no Bearer. Requires the X-CSRF-Token header to match the cv_csrf cookie. Rotates both.
Current admin + resolved permissions.
sessionId = a 24-hex id from List sessions.
Strength is enforced server-side. Revokes other sessions.
Cookie + CSRF, not Bearer. Always 200.

item.name: Public
item.description: No auth. Rate limit: publicLimiter. Responses are ETagged and CDN-cached.

request.description: The only unauthenticated write in the API. `company` is a honeypot — fill it and you get 200 with nothing written. mobile must be an Indian mobile (+91 optional, starts 6-9, 10 digits). type: consultation | enrollment | contact (see Lead model). Rate limit: formLimiter, per IP.

formdata.description: Pick an image. One file only.

request.description: multipart/form-data — do NOT set Content-Type by hand, Postman sets the boundary. Field name must be `file`. Goes straight to ImageKit; nothing is written to disk. Rate limit: uploadLimiter.
Which content documents use this asset. Check before deleting.
Destroys the remote ImageKit object. Super-admin AND content.purge.
